 Game Coverage: Listen Live Stats DePaul Travels to Evanston for First Road Test
 11/12/2026 8:03:00 PM | MEN'S BASKETBALL
 Game Notes (PDF) Share: EVANSTON, Ill. — DePaul men's basketball looks to move to 4-0 for the second time in three seasons as it faces its first road game of the year at Northwestern, Friday, Nov. 13. The Chicagoland rivalry is set for an 8 p.m. tip on Big Ten Network with Jack Rinaldi and Shon Morris on the call. DePaul's radio broadcast will be available on SiriusXM and the DePaul Blue Demons App with Zach Zaidman and Dave Corzine on the call.
 LAST TIME OUT 
The Blue Demons improved to 3-0 Monday, following an 84-47 victory over Alabama A&M. Layden Blocker led the charge with a season-high 20 points on 4-of-5 shooting from three-point range. The senior guard was joined by Kahmare Holmes , who posted a season-high 15 points in addition to six rebounds and two assists. Sophomore Kruz McClure added to DePaul's dominant performance with a team-high seven rebounds, six assists, and three steals. Five Blue Demons scored in double figures, and newcomer Ade Popoola knocked down four three-pointers for the third straight game.
 SCOUTING NORTHWESTERN 
Northwestern hosts DePaul at 3-0 after a 72-55 win over Boston University on Monday. The Wildcats have started 3-0 at home in six consecutive seasons and have yet to trail in a game this season. In their most recent outing, guards LA Pratt and Jake West combined for 41 points. West finished with a game-high 21 points and is the only player nationally with multiple 20-point, five-assist performances.
 THE SERIES 
The local series between DePaul and Northwestern dates back to 1912, with Friday's matchup being the 40th all-time meeting between the two schools. DePaul leads the all-time series, 21-18, but Northwestern has won eight of the last 10 meetings.
 UP NEXT 
DePaul hosts Maryland Eastern Shore back at Wintrust Arena on Tuesday, Nov. 17. The game will tip off at 7 p.m. on ESPN+.  
 FOLLOW THE BLUE DEMONS 
For all the latest information on DePaul Men's Basketball, please visit DePaulBlueDemons.com . For up-to-the-minute updates, follow the Blue Demons on X , Instagram and Facebook .  
 TICKET INFORMATION 
Join Blue Demon Nation for BIG EAST hoops at Wintrust Arena! Full season tickets for the 2026-27 season are on sale now, starting at just $275 per seat for men's basketball. Full season tickets include the same seat for every home game, plus special discounts for DePaul faculty, staff, retirees and recent graduates. Visit DePaulBlueDemons.com/Tickets to lock in your seats today.
